provenance.timelineNote: Recorded real Decider and Bedrock inference on a fictional scripted ATC scenario. Frames are observed persisted revisions, not a continuous browser recording. Short transitions between polls may be absent. Aircraft display uses the latest persisted scenario-allowed observation.
provenance.recordedObservationsSource: All persisted SNAPSHOT records in the final captured partition, restricted to their allowed lastObservation. This independent timeline does not add or alter sampled frames, model decisions, or cumulative metrics.
provenance.observationTimeOrigin: Elapsed milliseconds from the original session start; a negative value identifies an observation saved before the replay started.
provenance.eventAndDecisionTimeline: The final frame contains the complete captured events, assessments and activity records with original timestamps. Their timestamps can support a future derived replay; unsampled intermediate model decisions and cumulative metric totals have not been invented.
provenance.modelOutputs: Recorded structured decisions, proposed findings and published advisory text; no private chain of thought or unpersisted model responses.
